G1_compressibility.note: S_inference is a ZERO-OVERHEAD Amdahl upper bound, not a speedup claim

G1_sub_analysis_occlusion_change_failure.note: Per plan sec.9 G1 ('test new views and occlusion change'): incompressible work is a diffuse ~9-19% tile-count tail (by work only 0.6%), NOT concentrated in deepest-occlusion deciles; top-N pruning cannot remove it, needs higher rank or finer spatial partitioning (sec.6.1). This is a G1 sub-analysis, not the G2 gate.

G2_benefit_budget.formula: S = 1/(1 - p*f*(1 - 1/r) + h); p*f->q_weighted, r->gamma, h->overhead_fraction
G2_benefit_budget.inputs: measured G1 compressibility; zero fabricated GPU cost

binding_constraint.note: Future GPU renderer must keep real end-to-end overhead <= ~26.6% (gamma=2) or ~20.7% (gamma=4) for the 3x target to survive. This is the pass condition G3 measured overhead must fit inside. No speedup is claimed.

continuous_domain_certificate.reason: Rigorous continuous-domain error certificate (plan sec.5.5) requires interval arithmetic or dense domain coverage; reference implements only per-tile held-out-pixel fitting. Random held-out tests cannot bound error over the whole ray domain.

G3_conservative_e2e_bound.reason: Replaced by measured G3_gpu_microbenchmark. Prior entry required a full cost model with measured overhead; the microbench now measures per-tile latency directly.

G4_gpu_microbenchmark.method: Torch batchability probe on A100: batch B tiles into one student predict call; measure per-tile latency vs B.
G4_gpu_microbenchmark.finding: Student per-tile latency drops 181x from B=1 to B=256 (launch overhead amortizes to near-zero by B~128-256). The CGT student eval is highly batchable; the per-tile 1.2x is a launch-granularity artifact, not a fundamental limit. Batching/fusion recovers the 6-14x math headroom.
G4_gpu_microbenchmark.not_reported: S_batch (teacher/student) NOT used as speedup: teacher is B separate noisy calls (0.08ms B<=4 vs 0.38ms B>=8, artifact). Only the clean student batching curve is used.
G4_gpu_microbenchmark.verdict: PARTIAL: headroom recoverable via batching; TRUE G4 microbenchmark (fused CGT CUDA kernel vs gsplat fused rasterizer) still NOT_REACHED. A fused/batched kernel is the required G4 path.
G4_gpu_microbenchmark.scope_caveat: torch batchability probe, NOT fused CUDA kernel, NOT gsplat fused rasterizer; GPU not clock-locked.

G5_authoritative_e2e.reason: Requires native CGT training (route B, plan sec.6.3) + full renderer integration + independent >=3x validation. Not implemented (reference is frozen-teacher per-tile fitting, route A inference compression only).

G3_gpu_microbenchmark.method: torch GPU microbench on A100 reusing G1 gsplat tile extraction; teacher (M-Gauss) vs student (rank-R CGT) per-tile + intrinsic (launch-free) timing, CUDA events.
G3_gpu_microbenchmark.finding: Raw-math advantage is real and LARGER than assumed gamma=2-4 (measured 6.3-10.5x, growing with M). But at 256px/tile the GPU is launch-bound, so operational S is only ~1.18-1.20x. Count drops 6-10x but time does not (plan sec.9 G3 stop condition).
G3_gpu_microbenchmark.verdict: DO_NOT_ADVANCE_3X_AT_PER_TILE_GRANULARITY; math headroom real but launch-bound. Critical path = fused/batched CGT CUDA kernel (G4) to amortize launch.
G3_gpu_microbenchmark.pending_reason: GPUs 5/6/7 occupied by other users mid-run; idle-only constraint respected.
G3_gpu_microbenchmark.scope_caveat: torch reference math, NOT fused CGT kernel, NOT gsplat fused rasterizer; h_overhead is a lower bound (torch dispatch only, no spatial tree).

continuous_domain_certificate.method: Deterministic dense sub-pixel grid (sub=4 -> 4096 pts) over each tile 2D ray extent; student fit on even pixels (as G1), eval teacher-vs-student max|E,T| on dense grid + held-out odd pixels. 3 scenes x 2 views x ~10 work-decile tiles x ranks 4/8/16 = 60 fits/rank.
continuous_domain_certificate.finding: Dense coverage is a STRICTER test than random held-out: it exposes a hard-tile TAIL that random held-out partly masked. Pooled dense max|E,T| reaches 0.045-0.175 (vs gate 0.02); dense pass rate 0.97/0.88/0.85 at rank 4/8/16. Higher rank does NOT monotonically improve dense coverage (room pass 0.95->0.85->0.75 rank4->16), consistent with G1 Jacobian non-monotonicity. Worst tile: room rank4 M=310 dense_max_abs=0.175.
continuous_domain_certificate.scope_caveat: EMPIRICAL dense-coverage certificate: max error over a deterministic dense sub-pixel grid. NOT a rigorous interval-arithmetic bound over the continuum (that REMAINS NOT_REACHED). This is an ADD-ON continuous-domain probe; it is NOT the G1 gate (G1 = work-weighted compressibility, which PASSED). It TEMPERS any 'student reproduces teacher everywhere' claim by quantifying the incompressible hard-tile tail.
